# RMS analysis

I copied the config file, samples file, and profile examples from PIPELINE/ribomethseq and filled in w/ sample info.

Dry run
```
module load Mambaforge
mamba activate /n/whipple_lab/share_root/Users/cwhilden/ENVS/snakemake_py311
snake=/n/whipple_lab/share_root/Users/cwhilden/PIPELINE/ribomethseq/RMS.smk

cd /n/whipple_lab/share_root/Users/cwhilden/PROJECTS/THESIS/chapter2_RMS/
snakemake \
  --snakefile $snake \
  --configfile config.yaml \
  --dryrun
```

Dry run indicates 189 jobs needed. updated profile file.

Run:
```
snakemake --profile profiles/whipple-slurm \
  --snakefile $snake \
  --configfile config.yaml
```
